author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-09-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: No one will be above you.
context_before: You, as a person, will not be less than the Risen Lord, for there is only one Spirit. There is only one Lord and you will know yourself to be He!
context_after: I AM the same body, the same Lord, the same Spirit, the same God and Father of all. Without loss of identity, we will all know ourselves to be this one unity of being. We will know from experience that I AM in you and you are in me!
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am In You (1968-09-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-09-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: So I ask you: who is Paul?
context_before: In my own case, I was taken in Spirit into the presence of the Risen Lord, and – strangely enough – when he asked me what was the greatest thing in the world, I answered in the words of Paul.
context_after: Is he not the first of the chosen who broke the seal and discovered the mystery which was shown to Abraham?
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am In You (1968-09-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-09-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And any suffering you may go through here means nothing.
context_before: You were chosen in him before the drama we call the world began.
context_after: Paul knew this, and said: “I consider the sufferings of the present time not worth comparing to the glory which is to be revealed in us.”
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am In You (1968-09-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-09-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Was he not the beginner of the Christian faith?
context_before: When I stood in his presence, I answered his question in the words of Paul. Since then I have asked myself: who is Paul?
context_after: Our New Testament records thirteen of his letters, all written twenty years prior to the gospels.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am In You (1968-09-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-09-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: You see, there is no fiction.
context_before: Whoever has that account thinks this is an original idea, yet my friend knows she is its creator.
context_after: How can there be fiction in a world where imagining creates reality? For eight years her son has known the catalog to be a wish book, and now that has become its official name. If something you have imagined is delayed producing its reality for you, keep this story in mind.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am In You (1968-09-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-09-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: View the world from its fulfillment.
context_before: Find your desire in God’s wish book. Speaking to you through the medium of desire, make your desire real by feeling its truth.
context_after: Lose yourself in the feeling of possession and give it all the tones of reality. Fulfill every desire as you walk towards the fulfillment of your real purpose in life, which is to awaken God in you.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am In You (1968-09-30).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-09-30 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And when you awaken you will say, I AM awake.
context_before: In the parable the actor takes a little child in his arms and says: “This is the kingdom of heaven. Unless you accept the kingdom as a little child, you cannot enter it.” One day you will be that actor, and the little child in your arms will symbolize your entrance into heaven. It is a signal of God’s birth – not from the womb of a woman, but from the skull of man, where God is crucified. His name is I AM.
context_after: You will not look around for any other, for you will be alone; and from then on scripture will fulfill itself within you.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am In You (1968-09-30).
